core: Peroxisomal protein import, fission and pexophagy
qualifier: core set without TYSND1 processing or docking
name: Core peroxisomal protein import, fission and pexophagy
rationale: All members concern peroxisome biogenesis (membrane and matrix import, PEX5 recycling, fission) and peroxisome autophagy; it is the minimal set, lacking the TYSND1 cleavage, protein docking and unfolding terms of its superset twin and the fatty acid oxidation/synthesis of other peroxisome themes.

qualifier: with receptor docking and TYSND1 processing
name: Peroxisome protein docking, import, TYSND1 processing and pexophagy
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal membrane and matrix import, fission and pexophagy, and uniquely add protein-to-membrane docking, unfolding and TYSND1 cleavage of imported proteins, which the core twin lacks; no fatty acid oxidation as in other peroxisome themes.

qualifier: phenylalanine hydroxylation and phenylketonuria
name: Phenylalanine-to-tyrosine conversion, phenylketonuria and tyrosine breakdown
rationale: All members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism specifically, including phenylalanine hydroxylation and its disorder phenylketonuria, which the tyrosine-catabolism-only twin lacks, and without the generic L-amino acid terms of the broader twin.

qualifier: as the phenylalanine degradation route
name: Tyrosine catabolism within phenylalanine degradation
rationale: The three members are tyrosine catabolism and phenylalanine metabolism; unlike the related themes it lacks phenylalanine hydroxylation/phenylketonuria and generic amino acid catabolism terms.

qualifier: within general L-amino acid catabolism
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine within broad L-amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism and phenylketonuria plus generic alpha/L-amino acid and amide catabolism terms, which distinguishes it from the narrower phenylalanine-tyrosine themes.

core: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
qualifier: including antitumor NK response, without cell signatures
name: Enhanced NK and T cell cytotoxicity, including antitumor NK
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of NK or T cell killing (one toward tumor cells); it lacks the NK/T cell expression signatures and NK cytokine production of the larger twin.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxic program
qualifier: expression signatures with positive cytotoxicity regulation
name: NK and T cell signatures with positive cytotoxicity regulation
rationale: Members combine NK and T cell enrichment/surface signatures with positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity and NK cytokine production; the signatures distinguish it from the GO-only regulation twin and the absent inhibitory/KIR terms from other NK themes.

core: Postsynaptic GABA and NMDA receptor clustering
qualifier: neurexin-neuroligin assembly without transmission terms
name: Neurexin-neuroligin postsynaptic assembly with GABA and NMDA receptor clustering
rationale: Members are neurexin/neuroligin-driven postsynaptic assembly, gephyrin, GABA-A, NMDA and PSD-95 clustering and regulation of excitatory/inhibitory potentials; it lacks the glutamatergic transmission terms of its twin and the presynaptic adhesion terms of other synapse themes.

qualifier: with enhanced glutamatergic transmission
name: Postsynaptic receptor clustering with glutamatergic transmission enhancement
rationale: Members cover neuroligin-dependent GABA, NMDA and PSD-95 clustering and postsynaptic assembly, plus neuron-neuron transmission and positive regulation of glutamatergic transmission, which the twin lacks.

qualifier: amino acid terms only, no organic acid terms
name: Proline turnover, glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism
rationale: Members are proline synthesis and catabolism, glycine biosynthesis, glyoxylate metabolism and generic amino acid terms; it lacks the generic organic acid metabolism terms of its twin.

qualifier: within organic acid metabolism
name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate within organic acid metabolism
rationale: Same proline/glycine/glyoxylate core plus generic organic acid synthesis, catabolism and metabolism terms that the twin lacks; no glycine conjugation or threonine terms of other themes.

qualifier: biosynthetic side, without NTP interconversion or purine deoxynucleoside turnover
name: Pyrimidine synthesis, salvage and catabolism plus deoxyribonucleotide synthesis
rationale: Members cover de novo pyrimidine synthesis, UMP salvage, pyrimidine nucleotide/nucleobase catabolism and dNMP/dNTP synthesis; it lacks the nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion and purine deoxyribonucleoside catabolism of its twin.

qualifier: with purine deoxyribonucleoside turnover and NDP/NTP interconversion
name: Pyrimidine metabolism with purine deoxyribonucleotide turnover and NTP interconversion
rationale: Adds to the pyrimidine synthesis/salvage/catabolism core the purine deoxyribonucleoside and dNTP metabolism, deoxyribonucleotide catabolism and nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion that the twin lacks.

qualifier: coronavirus, with spike-induced cell-cell fusion
name: Coronavirus receptor-mediated attachment, entry and cell-cell fusion
rationale: Members are the SARS-CoV attachment-and-entry and cell-cell fusion pathways with GO receptor-mediated virion attachment and endocytosis; it lacks the dengue and RSV entry members of its twin.

qualifier: coronavirus, dengue and RSV
name: Coronavirus, dengue and RSV host-cell attachment, entry and fusion
rationale: Members are receptor-mediated attachment, endocytic entry and fusion for coronaviruses plus dengue and RSV entry (and dengue virion release), which distinguishes it from the coronavirus-only twin and from influenza or viral-maturation themes.

core: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion
qualifier: SDSA and sister chromatid exchange, without break-induced replication
name: Strand-invasion repair via SDSA and sister chromatid exchange
rationale: Members are strand invasion, repair synthesis, synthesis-dependent strand annealing, sister chromatid exchange and crosslink repair; it lacks break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and polymerase stimulation of its twin, and NHEJ/BRCA terms of others.

core: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion
qualifier: including break-induced replication and polymerase stimulation
name: Recombinational repair including break-induced replication and polymerase stimulation
rationale: Same strand-invasion/SDSA core plus break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and positive regulation of repair polymerase activity that the twin lacks; no NHEJ or checkpoint terms of other themes.

qualifier: adhesion molecule production, without diapedesis
name: Regulation of leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and adhesion molecule production
rationale: All four members regulate leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, extravasation or adhesion molecule production; it lacks the diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation terms of its twin and the monocyte/inflammation terms of others.

qualifier: neutrophil and T cell diapedesis
name: Regulation of neutrophil and T cell diapedesis and endothelial adhesion
rationale: Members add diapedesis, neutrophil migration and neutrophil and T cell extravasation to regulation of leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, distinguishing it from the adhesion-only twin and monocyte-centred themes.

qualifier: core D/E-series and DPA-derived SPMs only
name: Core omega-3 resolvin, protectin and DPA-derived SPM biosynthesis
rationale: All members are biosynthesis of classic D- and E-series resolvins, protectins and DPA-derived SPMs; it lacks the tissue-regeneration conjugates, 13-series resolvins, oxo-derivatives and HETE synthesis of its twin and the lipoxins of others.

qualifier: with tissue-regeneration conjugates and HETEs
name: Pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis including tissue-regeneration conjugates and HETEs
rationale: Members span resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis plus MCTR/PCTR/RCTR conjugates, maresin-like SPMs, 13-series resolvins, electrophilic oxo-derivatives and 5-/15-HETE synthesis, which the core twin lacks; no lipoxins or leukotrienes.

qualifier: with epigenetic rDNA control, without MYC or early pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase I transcription cycle and epigenetic rDNA regulation
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation, promoter escape, elongation and termination with NoRC, SIRT1, B-WICH and CSB control of rDNA chromatin; it lacks the MYC targets, 5'-ETS/ITS1 cleavage and heterochromatin terms of its twin and the Pol III themes' tRNA terms.

qualifier: with MYC targets and early pre-rRNA cleavage
name: MYC-linked rRNA transcription, nucleolar chromatin and early pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Adds MYC target signatures, 5'-ETS and ITS1 pre-rRNA cleavage, facultative heterochromatin and nucleolar protein localization to the Pol I transcription and rDNA chromatin core, which the twin lacks; no translation or Pol III terms.

core: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
qualifier: megakaryocyte-platelet emphasis, without granulopoiesis or monocyte terms
name: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte and platelet development from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members are RUNX1 control of HSC and megakaryocyte differentiation, megakaryocyte and platelet development, myeloid progenitor programs and restraint of erythroid and granulocyte fates; it lacks the granulopoiesis and monocyte/macrophage terms of its twin.

qualifier: with granulopoiesis and monocyte-macrophage restraint
name: RUNX1-directed megakaryopoiesis with granulopoiesis and monocyte-macrophage restraint
rationale: Same RUNX1 megakaryocyte and myeloid progenitor core plus transcriptional regulation of granulopoiesis and negative regulation of monocyte and macrophage differentiation, which the twin lacks; no erythroid maturation terms.
